text:
Subtracting 332 days from 2014-04-21:  
2014-04-21 back 21 days → 2014-03-31.  
Remaining 332 − 21 = 311 days.  
2014 is not a leap year, so back 311 days from 2014-03-31:  
311 − 31 (Mar) − 28 (Feb) − 31 (Jan) = 221 days left in 2013.  
From 2013-12-31 back 221 days: 2013-06-03.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 2013-06-03
